releases.title: Visible agent release notes
releases.summary: Adds user-facing release notes and improves live AI throughput by disabling the slower wildlife model during live RTSP testing.
changes: Adds a structured changelog for each agent version.
Shows the latest release notes in the local Agent Admin UI when an update is available.
Makes release notes available to the NodeVyu server for the web update interface.
Adds a test that requires the current agent version to have a changelog entry.
Disables wildlife inference during live RTSP AI testing so the general detector can run at a higher effective FPS.

releases.title: Live RTSP AI testing
releases.summary: Adds a temporary live AI test against a camera RTSP stream.
changes: Adds Start Live AI with 0.5, 1, and 2 AI FPS modes.
Keeps one FFmpeg RTSP connection open while testing.
Runs general and wildlife models on sampled frames.
Shows annotated live frames, detections, AI FPS, and inference latency.
Stops temporary live sessions when stopped, replaced, closed, or idle.

releases.title: Still-image AI testing
releases.summary: Adds image-based AI testing without requiring a live camera stream.
changes: Adds browser image upload testing.
Adds testing of an image file already stored on the agent.
Runs both general and wildlife models and returns an annotated preview.
Adds image size, type, and decoded-dimension safety limits.

releases.title: North American wildlife detection
releases.summary: Adds a managed wildlife model alongside the general object detector.
changes: Adds deer, rabbit, bear, fox, and coyote detection through a dedicated wildlife model.
Automatically provisions and verifies the wildlife ONNX model.
Does not guess goat or buck/doe labels when the model does not support them.
Keeps wildlife testing local to the agent.

releases.title: Animal detection and local evidence
releases.summary: Expands common animal detection and adds visual evidence for AI tests.
changes: Adds bird, cat, dog, horse, sheep, cow, bear, zebra, giraffe, and elephant to default detection classes.
Adds annotated detection previews.
Adds short local MP4 evidence clips when matching objects are detected.
Adds browser range support for local evidence playback.

releases.title: Managed AI model and version visibility
releases.summary: Automatically provisions the AI model and shows installed versus latest agent version.
changes: Automatically downloads and SHA-256 verifies the managed YOLOX-Tiny model after AI Detection is enabled.
Stores managed model data under the preserved agent data directory.
Shows installed version, latest version, and update status in the local Agent Admin UI.
Never overwrites a custom SITEWATCH_AI_MODEL_PATH.
